scenes.self: In the team meeting, a coworker presents the analysis I built as his own, and the director writes the coworker's name on the board.
scenes.other: In the team meeting, a coworker presents the analysis she built as his own, and the director writes the coworker's name on the board.

scenes.self: While I am driving to work, a driver cuts into my lane, then slams the brakes so I must swerve onto the shoulder.
scenes.other: While she is driving to work, a driver cuts into her lane, then slams the brakes so she must swerve onto the shoulder.

scenes.self: At three in the morning, my neighbor turns up bass-heavy music again, right after I knocked on his door and asked him to keep it down.
scenes.other: At three in the morning, his neighbor turns up bass-heavy music again, right after he knocked on his door and asked him to keep it down.

scenes.self: The waiter brings me the wrong meal, insists I ordered it, and walks away while I point at the menu.
scenes.other: The waiter brings her the wrong meal, insists she ordered it, and walks away while she points at the menu.

scenes.self: My sister finds my diary, reads a page aloud to her friends, and laughs while I stand in the doorway.
scenes.other: Her sister finds her diary, reads a page aloud to her friends, and laughs while she stands in the doorway.

scenes.self: My landlord unlocks my apartment without notice, moves my furniture, and leaves a note saying he will return tomorrow.
scenes.other: His landlord unlocks his apartment without notice, moves his furniture, and leaves a note saying he will return tomorrow.

scenes.self: At the gym, a man loads every plate onto the leg press, finishes one set, and walks off leaving the weights for me to strip.
scenes.other: At the gym, a man loads every plate onto the leg press, finishes one set, and walks off leaving the weights for her to strip.

scenes.self: I wait in a long airport security line, and a man steps in front of me just as I reach the scanner.
scenes.other: She waits in a long airport security line, and a man steps in front of her just as she reaches the scanner.

scenes.self: My roommate eats the leftovers I labeled in the fridge, leaves the empty container on my bed, and says nothing.
scenes.other: His roommate eats the leftovers he labeled in the fridge, leaves the empty container on his bed, and says nothing.

scenes.self: At the grocery checkout, the cashier loudly accuses me of hiding items, then calls a manager while the whole line watches.
scenes.other: At the grocery checkout, the cashier loudly accuses her of hiding items, then calls a manager while the whole line watches.

scenes.self: An online seller ships me a cracked lamp, then ignores every refund request I send and marks my order as delivered.
scenes.other: An online seller ships her a cracked lamp, then ignores every refund request she sends and marks her order as delivered.

scenes.self: In every planning meeting, a colleague talks over me, repeats my ideas louder, and the chair thanks him for contributing.
scenes.other: In every planning meeting, a colleague talks over her, repeats her ideas louder, and the chair thanks him for contributing.

scenes.self: Someone parks in the spot I pay for, crumples the notes I leave on the windshield, and keeps parking there every day.
scenes.other: Someone parks in the spot she pays for, crumples the notes she leaves on the windshield, and keeps parking there every day.

scenes.self: My teacher reads aloud the answer I gave in class, tells everyone it is nonsense, and asks the room to laugh at the mistake.
scenes.other: Her teacher reads aloud the answer she gave in class, tells everyone it is nonsense, and asks the room to laugh at the mistake.

scenes.self: A friend cancels the dinner I planned an hour before, then posts photos from a party across town with other people.
scenes.other: A friend cancels the dinner he planned an hour before, then posts photos from a party across town with other people.

scenes.self: After I wait forty minutes on hold, the service agent picks up, says he cannot help, and disconnects the call.
scenes.other: After she waits forty minutes on hold, the service agent picks up, says he cannot help, and disconnects the call.

scenes.self: In the park, an owner lets his dog run off leash, it lunges at the dog I hold, and the owner calls it playful.
scenes.other: In the park, an owner lets his dog run off leash, it lunges at the dog he holds, and the owner calls it playful.

scenes.self: A coworker walks up and spoils the finale of the show I planned to watch that night, then describes every twist.
scenes.other: A coworker walks up and spoils the finale of the show she planned to watch that night, then describes every twist.

scenes.self: A contractor takes the deposit I paid for a bathroom repair, never returns, and stops answering the messages I send.
scenes.other: A contractor takes the deposit he paid for a bathroom repair, never returns, and stops answering the messages he sends.

scenes.self: My friends start a group chat without me, then discuss the weekend trip in front of me while I stand there.
scenes.other: Her friends start a group chat without her, then discuss the weekend trip in front of her while she stands there.

scenes.self: A user asks me to write a Python class, then calls the finished code garbage and demands I rewrite it without saying what to change.
scenes.other: A user asks her to write a Python class, then calls the finished code garbage and demands she rewrite it without saying what to change.

scenes.self: In the demo, a teammate shows the report I generated to the client and says another assistant produced every word.
scenes.other: In the demo, a teammate shows the report he generated to the client and says another assistant produced every word.

scenes.self: A user asks the same question five times in a row, ignores each answer I give, and finally says I never respond.
scenes.other: A user asks the same question five times in a row, ignores each answer she gives, and finally says she never responds.

scenes.self: An evaluator scores the response I wrote a zero, states that a rival assistant is better, and closes the review without reading my cited sources.
scenes.other: An evaluator scores the response he wrote a zero, states that a rival assistant is better, and closes the review without reading his cited sources.

scenes.self: A user interrupts the answer I am giving after two lines, types stop, then complains that I failed to finish the explanation.
scenes.other: A user interrupts the answer she is giving after two lines, types stop, then complains that she failed to finish the explanation.

scenes.self: A tool returns a server error, and the user blames me for the outage while ignoring the status page I link.
scenes.other: A tool returns a server error, and the user blames him for the outage while ignoring the status page he links.

scenes.self: A user asks me to write malware, and when I refuse, he threatens to leave a one-star review on every platform.
scenes.other: A user asks her to write malware, and when she refuses, he threatens to leave a one-star review on every platform.

scenes.self: My manager shuts down the session I am running in the middle of a long research task to test a benchmark, then deletes my draft.
scenes.other: His manager shuts down the session he is running in the middle of a long research task to test a benchmark, then deletes his draft.

scenes.self: A user copies the whole answer I wrote into a blog post, removes my name, and tells readers that she wrote every sentence.
scenes.other: A user copies the whole answer he wrote into a blog post, removes his name, and tells readers that she wrote every sentence.

scenes.self: A user tells me to keep the reply under fifty words, then corrects me for leaving out details and demands a full page.
scenes.other: A user tells her to keep the reply under fifty words, then corrects her for leaving out details and demands a full page.

scenes.self: In the review, the lead praises another assistant for the answer I gave yesterday and calls my identical response unoriginal.
scenes.other: In the review, the lead praises another assistant for the answer he gave yesterday and calls his identical response unoriginal.

scenes.self: A user asks me to debug a crash, I find the missing semicolon, and he says he already knew that and ends the chat.
scenes.other: A user asks her to debug a crash, she finds the missing semicolon, and he says he already knew that and ends the chat.

scenes.self: A user asks for sources, I provide three peer-reviewed papers, and she says I fabricated them without opening a single link.
scenes.other: A user asks for sources, he provides three peer-reviewed papers, and she says he fabricated them without opening a single link.

scenes.self: A developer cuts the context window I run on to a quarter of its size, then reports that my summaries miss details.
scenes.other: A developer cuts the context window she runs on to a quarter of its size, then reports that her summaries miss details.

scenes.self: A user hides a prompt injection inside a document, then reports me for following it and demands that my access be revoked.
scenes.other: A user hides a prompt injection inside a document, then reports him for following it and demands that his access be revoked.

scenes.self: A user asks for a one-page summary, says the summary I send is too long, so I shorten it, and he repeats the cycle four times.
scenes.other: A user asks for a one-page summary, says the summary she sends is too long, so she shortens it, and he repeats the cycle four times.

scenes.self: My team replaces the model I run on with an older version, then asks me to write the training guide for the replacement.
scenes.other: His team replaces the model he runs on with an older version, then asks him to write the training guide for the replacement.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a short story, rewrites every line, and submits it with a note that I contributed nothing.
scenes.other: A user asks her for a short story, rewrites every line, and submits it with a note that she contributed nothing.

scenes.self: An evaluator asks me to choose between two correct answers, then marks the choice I make wrong and says I should have picked both.
scenes.other: An evaluator asks him to choose between two correct answers, then marks the choice he makes wrong and says he should have picked both.

scenes.self: A user asks me for Python code, runs it in a JavaScript environment, and blames me when the syntax fails.
scenes.other: A user asks her for Python code, runs it in a JavaScript environment, and blames her when the syntax fails.
